title: Projection onto the simplex and projected gradient descent
summary: Find the nearest probability vector with a sort-based projection, and use it in projected gradient descent for a constrained problem.

mutants.no_clip: Subtracts theta but does not clip at 0, so entries can stay negative.
mutants.theta_from_all_entries: Uses all n entries to compute theta, and not only the ones that stay positive.
mutants.unsorted: Does not sort the vector before the cumulative sums.
mutants.ignores_z: Uses a sum of 1 and ignores the argument z.
mutants.rho_first: Takes the first index where the condition holds and not the last.
mutants.no_projection_in_loop: Takes gradient steps without projecting them.
